'''Lookout''' was one of the [[subnode]]s of the legendary [[Assembler]] [[Spider/Legends|arachnid]] [[Kud'ar Mub'at]]. It was charged with looking through a single-[[Eye/Legends|eye]] lens and viewing the exterior of the [[Ghostling Nest of the Assembler]].<ref name="EGTAS" />
